s: tri, (na viBAjyam । naYtatpuruzaH .) viBAgAyogyaM । aTa viBAjyAviBAjye । tatra vyAsaH । “anASritya pitfdravyaM svaSaktyApnoti yadDanaM । dAyAdeByo na taddadyAt vidyAlabDaYca yadBavet” ॥ * ॥ vidyADanamAha kAtyAyanaH । “upanyaste tu yallabDaM vidyayA paRapUrvvakaM । vidyADanantu tadvidyAt viBAge na niyojayet ॥ SizyAdArtvijyataH praSnAt sandigDapraSnanirRayAt । svajYAnasaMSanAdvAdAllabDaM prADyayanAttu yat ॥ vidyADanantu tatprAhurviBAge na prayojayet । Silpezvapi hi Darmmo'yaM mUlyAdyaccADikaM Bavet ॥ paraM nirasya yallabDaM vidyayA DUtapUrvvakaM । vidyADanantu tadvidyAt na viBAjyaM vfhaspatiH” ॥ * ॥ yadi BavAn Badramupanyasyati tadA Bavata eva mayEtaddeyamiti paRitaM yatropanyAsaM nistIryya laBate tanna viBAjyaM । SizyAdaDyApitAt । ArtvijyataH yajamAnAddakziRayA labDaDanaM na pratigrahalabDaM vetanarUpatvAttasya । taTA yatkiYcidvidyApraSne nistIrRe'paRitaM yadi kaScit paritozAdfdAti । taTA yo'smin SAstrArTe asmAkaM saMSayamapanayati tasmE DanamidaM dadAnItyupasTitasya saMSayamapanIya yallabDaM । vAdinorvvA sandehe nyAyakaraRArTamAgatayoH samyaNnirUpaRena yallabDaM zazWAMSAdikaM taTA SAstrAdiprakfzwajYAnaM samBAvya yat pratigrahAdinA labDaM । taTA SAstrajYAnavivAde anyatrApi yatra kutracidanyonyajYAnavivAde nirjjitya yallabDaM । taTEkasmin deye bahUnAmupaplave yena prahfzwAt yallabDaM । taTA SilpAdividyayA citrakarasuvarRakArAdiBiryallabDaM । taTA dyUtenApi paraM nirjjitya yallabDaM । tatsarvvamaviBAjyamitarEH । tasmAdyayA kayAcidvidyayA labDamarjjakasyEva tannetarezAmiti । pradarSanArTantu kAtyAyanena vistAritamiti dAyaBAgaH ॥ * ॥ nAradaH । “kuwumbaM biBfyAdBrAturyo vidyAmaDigacCataH । BAgaM vidyADanAttasmAt sa laBetASruto'pi san” ॥ biBfyAdityekavacananirdeSAnna bahavaH । yadi vidyAmaByasyato BrAtuH kuwumbamaparo BrAtA svaDanavyayaSarIrAyAsAmyAM saMvardDayati tadA tadvidyArjjitaDane tasyADikAraH । aSruto mUrKaH । kalpatarumitAkzarAdIpakalikAsu । kAtyAyanaH । “paraBaktopayogena vidyA prAptAnyatasta yA । tayA labDaM DanaM yattu vidyAlabDaM taducyate” ॥ anyataH pitfmAtfkulavyatiriktAt ॥ * ॥ atra viSezayati sa eva । “nAvidyAnAntu vEdyena deyaM vidyADanAt kvacit । samavidyADikAnAntu deyaM vEdyena tadDanaM” ॥ tatroccaritavidyApadamumAByAM sambaDyate tena samavidyADikavidyAnAM BAgo na tu nyUnavidyayoH । vEdyena viduzA ॥ * ॥ punarvviSezayati । “kule vinItavidyAnAM BrAtFRAM pitfto'pi vA । SOryyaprAptantu yadvittaM viBAjyaM tadvfhaspatiH” ॥ kule svakule pitAmahapitfvyAdiByaH । pitfta eva vA । SikzitavidyAnAM BrAtFRAM । yadvidyASOryyaprAptaM DanaM tadviBajanIyamiti kalpataruratnAkarO । punaH kAtyAyanaH ॥ “dvyaMSaharo'rdDaharo vA puttravittArjjanAt pitA” । puttravittArjjanAt । kfdaBihitaBAvo dravyavat prakASata iti nyAyAt puttrArjjitavittAt piturdvyaMSitvaM pitfDanAnupaGAtavizayaM BrAtfDanopaGAtavizayaYca । arjjakasya tu dvyaMSitvaM BrAtfDanopaGAte tu tezAmapyekAMSitvaM vakzyamARavyAsavacanAt । piturardDaharatvantu pitfdravyopaGAtAdguRavattvAdveti dAyaBAgaH । anupaGAte pitA dvyaMSaharaH arjjakatvAt svayamapi dvyaMSaharaH itarezAmanaMSitvaM । BrAtfdravyopaGAte tu tasyApyekAMSa iti dvyaMSArdDAMSayorBedakaTanaM ॥ * ॥ punaH kAtyAyanaH । “gIpracAraSca raTyA ca vastraM yaccANgayojitaM । prAyojyaM na viBajyeta SilpArTantu vfhaspatiH” ॥ prAyojyaM yadyasya prayojanArhaM pustakAdi na tanmUrKAdiBiH saha paRqitAdiBirvviBajanIyaM evameva dAyaBAgamadanapArijAtAdayaH । yAjYavalkyaH । “pitfByAYcEva yaddattaM tattasyEva DanaM Bavet” । puttraduhitroryadalaNkArAdi dattaM tattasyEveti SUlapARyupADyAyAH ॥ nAradaH । “SOryyaBAryyADane coBe yacca vidyADanamBavet । trIRyetAnyaviBAjyAni prasAdo yaSca pEtfkaH” ॥ prAptaYca saha BAryyayeti BaradvAjavacanAt BAryyAprAptikAle labDaM DanaM BAryyADanamOdvAhikamityarTaH । coBe ityatra hitveti pAWe etattrikaM hitvAnyadviBajedityanuvarttate ata etAnyaviBAjyAnIti । na vAstaviBAgo nodakapAtrAlaNkAropayuktastrIvAsasAmapAM pracAraraTyAnAM viBAgaSca iti prajApatiriti । yasmin vAstuni yena gfhodyAnAdikaM kftaM apareRApi sTAnAntare taTA kftaYcet tadA yena yat kftaM tattasyEva । anyatrApyevaM ॥ * ॥ sADAraRaDanArjjite'pi viSezamAha vyAsaH । “sADAraRaM samASritya yatkiYcidvAhanAyuDaM । SOryyAdinApnoti DanaM BrAtarastatra BAginaH ॥ tasya BAgadvayaM deyaM SezAstu samaBAginaH” । atra BrAtara ityupalakzaRaM pitfvyAdayo'pi bodDavyAH । tasyArjakasya । sADAraRopaGAte yasya yAvato'SasyAlpasya mahato vA upaGAtastasya tadanusAreRa BAgakalpanA kAryyeti dAyaBAgaH ॥ yAjYavalkyaH । “kramAdaByAgataM dravyaM hftamaByudDarettu yaH । dAyAdeByo na taddadyAt vidyayA labDameva ca” ॥ pitfpitAmahAgataM balAdanyErhftaM yo'MSyantarARAmanujYayA udDarati tadaMSyantareByo na dadyAt ॥ * ॥ BUmO tu viSezayati SaNKaH । “pUrvvanazwAYca yo BUmimeka evodDaret SramAt । yaTABAgaM Bajantyanye dattvAMSantu tUrIyakaM” ॥ etadvacanaM smftimahArRavakAmaDenupArijAtapraBftizvaliKanAdayuktameveti ratnAkaraH । tanna, dAyaBAgamitAkzarApraBftiBirDftatvAt । iti dAyatattvaM ॥

m: अ-विशेष m. non-distinction, non-difference, uniformity, Kap.
अ-विशेष mfn.without difference, uniform, BhP.; Kap. &c.
अ-विशेष n. pl. (in Sāṃkhya phil.) N. of the (five) elementary substances (cf. तन्-मात्र)
a: अविशेष — a. Without any difference, alike, similar, uniform. --षः, --षं 1 Absence of difference, uniformity, similarity. --2 Identity, sameness. --3 The subtle elements (in Sān. phil.). --Comp. --ज्ञ a. not knowing the difference (in things), undiscriminating.

अ-विशेष—वत् mfn. not making a difference between (loc.), Yājñ. iii, 154.

अ-विश्रम्भिन् mfn. diffident, Bhaṭṭ.
अ-विश्रम mfn. unceasing, unremitting, Śak. (v.l.).

not examined with regard to cleanness or purity, Kām.

a: अविश्वासिन् — a. Mistrusting, unbelieving, diffident.
